_comment: Independent C-first single-attacker variation for mhitu.c:mattacku -> uhitm.c:mhitm_knockback's hero-defender branch -> dothrow.c:hurtle. Two wished digging wands open east and west before one hostile MZ_HUGE giant mummy is created; the source `test_move` destination is therefore not a room wall for either aligned horizontal attack. The human Wizard uses the source 30-turn invulnerable timeout while the fixed wait string supplies ordinary attack opportunities. This is not a seed search; the one-monster quantity is frozen as a cheap variation. The source `potion.c:make_stunned` call remains an explicit unported void gap; retain only if C reaches hurtle and the full JS replay matches its actual non-stun branch.
